title: Z-LFS: A Zoned Namespace-tailored Log-structured File System for Commodity Small-zone ZNS SSDs
problem: Commodity ZNS SSDs with small zones create sequential-write constraints that traditional log-structured file systems cannot efficiently satisfy, causing zone fragmentation, premature resets, and performance degradation.
motivation: As ZNS SSDs become commodity hardware, file systems must be co-designed with their zone architecture to achieve competitive I/O performance and storage efficiency.
method: Z-LFS implements a zone-aware log-structured design that segments the write buffer and logical address space into zone-aligned units, applies zone-cognizant garbage collection to minimize resets, and uses adaptive zone mapping to tolerate small zone boundaries while maintaining sequential write properties.
key_novelty: First production-ready log-structured file system optimized specifically for small-zone ZNS SSDs in commodity devices.
contributions: Zone-tailored log-structured file system architecture for commodity ZNS SSDs
Mechanisms for efficient garbage collection and reset minimization under small-zone constraints
Performance characterization and optimization tradeoffs for zone size sensitivity
Open-source implementation and comparison against traditional and flash-aware file systems

metrics.other: I/O throughput, latency, zone utilization efficiency
